messages:
Priya Nair: hey team, onboarding q — trying to spin up a quick dev vm and hit a permissions wall. I filled out the cloud access request but it keeps failing at the Billing Account lookup. Anyone seen this today? :confused:
Jorge Ruiz: welcome Priya! :wave: If the form can't validate the Billing Account ID it's usually a formatting issue. Make sure it looks like `012345-678901-234567` (with dashes). If that still fails ping me the ID and I can attach it. Which project name do you want?
Priya Nair: thx Jorge. Project id: `redwood-onboard-priya`. Billing ID I entered: `012345678901234567` (no dashes) — ah that must be it. Can you also give me `roles/compute.instanceAdmin.v1` and `roles/browser` for now? Need to test a startup script that hits KMS.
Jorge Ruiz: yep, that no-dash format is why validation blew up. I fixed the billing attach and kicked off project creation. Gave you `roles/browser` and `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` for the project — I'll add compute admin in a follow-up ACL change. Also added you to `redwood-devs` group which has common perms.
cloud-ops-bot: Ticket CLOUD-4712 opened by jorge for project redwood-onboard-priya. Estimated ETA: 20m.
Priya Nair: awesome. KMS question — the onboarding script needs to decrypt a token. Who do I ask to be added to the key ring? The key path in docs is `projects/redwood-common/locations/us/keyRings/onboard/cryptoKeys/onboard-key`.
Leah Kim: hi Priya, Leah from infra here. For that key you need `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on the key resource. We usually add folks to group `onboard-kms-users` to simplify. I can add you now. Quick note: KMS access is scoped to the location — if you need keys in `us` and `eu` we need separate additions.
Priya Nair: just `us` for now. thanks Leah. Also for AWS — our onboarding doc mentions an assume-role to `arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/Redwood-Dev-Onboard`. Do I need an AWS console invite or will it be federated?
Jorge Ruiz: we use SSO for most hires. Your SSO account should already be in the AWS org. If you can't see the role, ping me and I'll add a trust policy entry. Regions allowed on dev are `us-west-2` and `eu-central-1` by default. If you want APAC regions file a `cloud-compliance` ticket.
Priya Nair: I see the role in the console now, thanks. Quick test command for assuming role from CLI if others need it later:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/Redwood-Dev-Onboard --role-session-name priya-onboard --duration-seconds 3600
```
Priya Nair: accepted the AWS SSO prompt. Spun up a t2.medium in us-west-2 and test script decrypted the token successfully. all good. Thanks for the fast help! :tada:
Leah Kim: great news — closing CLOUD-4712 once billing settled. If any perms pop up, drop them here or tag #eng-infra. Welcome aboard! :raised_hands:
